how_to_apply: Visit the CSIR-NEIST website and access the online application link at neist.res.in/prostaff/.
Click on "CLICK HERE TO APPLY" for submission of the application.
Apply for the concerned Post Code by clicking the "POST NAME".
Complete the online form following the instructions provided below the boxes.
Submit the application form and note the generated Registration Number displayed on the computer screen.
Download the registration form from the "DOWNLOAD" section of the portal.
Print and submit a signed copy of the registration form along with original testimonials at the time of the interview.
important_instructions: Separate applications must be submitted for each Post Code. Candidates must bring all original testimonials, mark sheets, certificates, and a clear photograph on the date of the interview. Shortlisting will be based on academic performance and experience, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the offline interview at CSIR-NEIST, Jorhat. Project staff presently working in CSIR-NEIST must obtain an NOC before applying for other project vacancies. The engagement is purely temporary, co-terminus with the project duration, and does not confer any right for regularization. Result-awaited candidates are not eligible to apply. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification released by CSIR – North East Institute of Science & Technology, Jorhat to fill 24 Project Staff vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies available for various Project Associate, Senior Project Associate, Project Technical Support, Project Assistant, and Assistant Project Manager posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 17 October 2026 up to 05:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSIR NEIST Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post code and include M.Sc., B.Tech, BE, or PhD in relevant disciplines such as Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Life Science, Chemistry, Computer Science, or Botany.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit ranges from 35 years to 55 years depending on the post code, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, candidates do not need to pay any application fee to apply for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for CSIR NEIST Project Staff posts?
faq.answer: Applicants will be shortlisted based on academic performance and experience, followed by an offline interview held at CSIR-NEIST, Jorhat in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for CSIR NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The tentative date of the interview is 02 November 2026.
